SAMPLE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This is a made-up document used only to test software. It is not a real contract and it is not legal advice.

This Services Agreement is made on 1 January 2027 between Example Studio Pvt Ltd (the Client) and Sample Vendor Pvt Ltd (the Supplier).

1. Services. The Supplier shall provide website design and maintenance services to the Client as described in each work order signed by both parties.

2. Fees. The Client shall pay each invoice within thirty days of receiving it. Late payments carry interest at one percent per month.

3. Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or for no reason, by giving thirty days written notice to the other party. Termination under this clause does not require either party to show cause.

4. Limitation of Liability. In no event shall the total liability of either party under this Agreement exceed the fees paid by the Client in the twelve months before the claim arose, except as stated in clause 5.

5. Exceptions. Nothing in this Agreement limits or caps the liability of either party for fraud, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of confidentiality, and such liability shall be unlimited.

6. Non-Compete. During this Agreement and for twelve months afterwards, the Supplier shall not provide services that compete with the Client's business to any other design studio in the same city.

7. Assignment. Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement or any right under it to any third party without the prior written consent of the other party.

8. Change of Ownership. If the Supplier is acquired or merges with another company, the Client may review the arrangement and discuss any changes with the new owner.

9. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret and use it only for the purpose of this Agreement.

10. General. This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties. Any change must be in writing and signed by both parties.

Signed for the Client: ______________________    Signed for the Supplier: ______________________

clauses.text: 3. Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or for no reason, by giving thirty days written notice to the other party. Termination under this clause does not require either party to show cause.
clauses.explanation: Either side can end this contract without giving a reason. That gives flexibility, but the other side could also leave at short notice. Check how much notice is required. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

clauses.text: 4. Limitation of Liability. In no event shall the total liability of either party under this Agreement exceed the fees paid by the Client in the twelve months before the claim arose, except as stated in clause 5.
clauses.explanation: This clause sets an upper limit on how much one side can owe the other. A limit usually protects the party that might have to pay. Check that the limit is a sensible amount. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

clauses.text: 5. Exceptions. Nothing in this Agreement limits or caps the liability of either party for fraud, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of confidentiality, and such liability shall be unlimited.
clauses.explanation: This clause says liability has no upper limit in certain cases, such as fraud or gross negligence. If something goes wrong, the amount owed could be very large. Check which cases are covered. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

notes.text: Ask the studio manager which cases this covers before signing.

clauses.text: 6. Non-Compete. During this Agreement and for twelve months afterwards, the Supplier shall not provide services that compete with the Client's business to any other design studio in the same city.
clauses.explanation: This clause stops one side from working with competitors for a period of time. It can limit future business. Check how long it lasts and how wide it is. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

clauses.text: 7. Assignment. Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement or any right under it to any third party without the prior written consent of the other party.
clauses.explanation: This clause says the contract cannot be handed to someone else without the other side's consent. It protects you from an unknown new partner. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

clauses.text: 8. Change of Ownership. If the Supplier is acquired or merges with another company, the Client may review the arrangement and discuss any changes with the new owner.
clauses.explanation: This may be a clause about what happens if a company is bought or changes owners. The AI is not sure about it, so please read it yourself and confirm or correct the label. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.

missing_clauses.explanation: No governing law clause was found. This clause says which country or state law applies if there is a dispute. Without it, deciding which law applies can be difficult. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.
